phrases.latin: Theodōrum ad orbitās properantem pater inclāmāvit: «Stā īlicō! Dā mihi manum.»
phrases.english: As Theo hurried towards the tracks, Dad called out to him, “Stop right there! Give me your hand.”
phrases.source: Libellus V, Lisbōna: castellum et ōceanārium

sources: Lewis & Short: ilico
